name: Wicked Sister

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Spike Grenades
perks.desc:
Grenades fired from this weapon do increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Alloy Casing
perks.desc:
Reduces weight for faster reloads.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Augmented Drum
perks.desc:
Heavy, high capacity drum.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: High-Explosive Ordnance
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are larger and travel faster.
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases magazine size

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Mini Frags
perks.desc:
Grenades are smaller and more compact for easier reloading.
  •  Increases magazine size
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Sticky Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon attach on impact and detonate when enemies are in proximity.

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Disorienting Grenades
perks.desc:
Detonation has a brief disorienting effect. 
  •  Greatly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.desc: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.desc: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Cascade Point
perks.desc: Final blows or sustained precision hits with another weapon increase this weapon's rate of fire for a short duration.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Full Court
perks.desc: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels further before exploding.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

perks.name: Nadir Focus
perks.desc: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 124 from 19 November 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3n08KP410ui1TXoEdBmsvu?si=2badf5a8fcac408d) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for sustained boss damage in general, and end-game underleveled content. Wicked Sister is here for Guardians who, for any reason, can't run Trials, Raids or Dungeons, providing an A-Tier choice for boss damage. It does drop from Vanguard activities with a 12×12 trait perk pool, so if you're after it, reset your Zavala rank as many times as you're able before focusing. At base the stats are okay - 40 Handling is 0.44s ready, 0.43s ADS and 0.39s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 41 is a 3.24s reload. Mag size is 5 (max is 8) and with 0/1/2/3 reserve mods, you'll start with total ammo of 24/26/28/28 (max is 31). For a sustained damage roll, focus on Velocity and Handling with the barrel perk, and mag size with the magazine perk. The ideal trait combination is Envious Arsenal and Bait and Switch, to reload and proc a ×1.3 damage boost for 10s when you rotate through your weapons but, if you don't drop that, then other first trait perk column perks with considering are Field Prep to boost your ammo reserves and reload speed, or Auto-Loading Holster to reload while you continue damage with your special weapon, can work. The Nadir Focus origin Trait boosts your projectile velocity, so pairs well. Recommended MW: Handling or Velocity, with a Backup Mag mod.

Wicked Sister is here for Guardians who, for any reason, can't run Trials, Raids or Dungeons. Add-clearing isn't really what heavy GLs are for but, if you were looking for an option, maximise the Blast Radius with the barrel and magazine perks. In the second trait perk column, Chair Reaction detonations then extend the lethal radius on kills. First column perks worth considering are Envious Assassin to overflow your mag with kills from other weapons, Field Prep to boost your ammo reserves and reload speed, Clown Cartridge to overflow your magazine, or Auto-Loading Holster to simply reload in the background. pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Wicked Sister was not a weapon I thought would be reintroduced. It fell way under the radar back in Year 1 but now is back and immediately outclasses many other grenade launchers. Clown Cartridgento Envious Arsenal, Field Prep or Auto-Loading Holster; you've got your choice in the third column. Pair that with again your choice of Explosive Light, Bait and Switch or Cascade Point and you've got a solid workhorse for most any activity." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "With the health changes you're going to want to push for greater than 70 Blast radius. Wicked Sister can hit that and get Impulse Amplifier for boosted velocity. I prefer Explosive Light in the last column to really push up the damage on non-direct hits but Chain Reaction is also great if your aim is better than mine." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.
